visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a pair of chubby toddler hands reaching into a dark-colored bin filled with dark roasted coffee beans. The hands are seen digging into and swirling the beans, which have a glossy texture and vary in shades of dark brown. (2) The perspective shifts to a medium shot revealing a young boy wearing a red shirt and a bib with cartoon character prints. He is sitting on the floor next to a white plastic bin and a black plastic bin. Beside him, a man with a beard and short dark hair wearing a black hoodie with a Mercedes logo observes closely. The background is an indoor workspace with stacks of boxes and a glass door showing outdoor greenery. (3) The man leans forward and affectionately kisses the boy on the head while the child continues to focus intently on picking up individual coffee beans from the white bin and placing them into the black one. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from the glass door. (4) A series of quick cuts shows the boy continuing the task of sorting coffee beans. The camera remains at an eye-level perspective relative to the seated subjects. The man occasionally uses his hands to steady the bins. The setting remains consistent, appearing to be a home-based coffee studio or a cafe storage area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a bright acoustic guitar strumming a rhythmic folk-pop progression accompanied by a male vocalist singing in English. A distinct percussive texture of coffee beans shuffling against plastic is layered into the mix, creating a rhythmic crunch. (2) As the music maintains a steady 95 BPM tempo, the sound of beans being dropped into a bin creates sharp, mid-frequency transients that align with the musical beat. (3) A 'whoosh' or 'click' transition sound effect is heard, signaling a scene change. The incidental noise of plastic bins scraping against the floor is clearly audible but integrated into the acoustic soundscape. (4) The song concludes with a final guitar strum and a soft thud sound, maintaining high spectral clarity and a warm, professional mastering tone throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To build a brand image for 'Super Serious Coffee' (超認真咖啡) by showcasing the painstaking manual bean-selection process through the heartwarming lens of a father-child activity, ultimately driving viewers to the brand's Instagram profile for purchase.
